title: Helix 2.5: Zero-Shot 30-Home Generalization
publication_date_evidence: Date printed on the official Figure report
problem: 能否预测人类行为预训练数据对机器人迁移的收益，而不混淆离线损失和闭环成功。
insight: 固定模型与下游训练，扫描人类数据规模；另用预训练消融检查未见家庭中的任务执行。
method: Four nested Index subsets spanning 8x data; fixed model size and downstream training; held-out action-prediction loss. Separate pretraining ablation across three behaviors and 30 unseen homes.
result: Largest-run loss forecast error reported as 0.54% of loss variation over the measured data range; separate whole-task success comparison 9% versus 56%.
limitation: Developer-reported evidence with four scale points; no joint compute/model law or arbitrary-task success extrapolation. Zero-shot concerns homes and objects, not absence of task-specific training. No independent replication by this survey.

title: Hyperparameter Scaling Laws Across MoE Sparsity

insight: 将专家激活比例 A 作为独立预测变量，分别以 (C,A) 和 (D,A) 拟合峰值学习率与全局 token batch；留组预测并在预先冻结的超稀疏配置上检验。
limitation: 单一骨干、语料、Muon、路由与调度；一个联合外推目标；激活参数量未超出拟合范围；全网格多种子覆盖不足；候选函数区间重叠；不构成下游能力定律。

method: Expert activation ratio supplements the existing scale variables in multiplicative power-law models for peak LR and global token batch. The gradient-noise explanation in §3.2 is an author-proposed mechanism; its Appendix C derivation was not audited. Leave-one-activation-ratio-out and leave-one-active-scale-out at whole loss-surface level; optimum extraction and fitting use training folds. Their primary grouped errors concern hyperparameter coordinates, not validation-loss predictions.
result: Within the studied recipe, increasing sparsity shifts the preferred learning rate downward at fixed compute and token batch upward at fixed data; one frozen joint-extrapolation target lies near the observed optimum.

title: How Much Is an AI Token Worth? Scaling Laws for Wild AI-Generated Web Text

limitation: 800 个不足 1B 的模型、单配方、英语、检测器标签；添加数据增加计算量；loss 不等于能力；保留大规模实验同时参与候选形式比较，不能称为完全独立的最终测试；未复现。

title: Paired Multimodal Scaling Laws
problem: 模态总量相同时，配对关系是否仍改变可学习的信息？
insight: 把配对数量作为独立资源，区分冗余、各模态独有和协同信息。
method: Fixed per-modality counts and updates; Digits, frozen-encoder VQA heads and NLVR2 fine-tuning; four-channel fits.

limitation: Labeled-row count and epochs change; failed-to-start NLVR2 seeds filtered; calibrated loss; no generative-pretraining or frontier-scale validation.

title: Emergent Inverse-Depth Scaling From Nonlinearity In Attention
problem: 数据谱之外，非线性 attention 如何改变深度收益？
insight: 选择性检索与层间聚合可抵消预测分歧，共享误差保留为平台。
method: Controlled ICL label copying and top-k aggregation; linear/nonlinear attention, depth fits and error decomposition.
result: Approximately inverse-depth excess loss above a fitted floor on top-2; the isotropic extension with context updates gives a saturating top-16 counterexample.
limitation: Decomposition alone does not fix the exponent; simplified converged MSE experiments, no real-language or joint width/data/compute test.
changes_existing_conclusion: Adds a conditional depth mechanism alongside spectral explanations, including an explicit counterexample.
evidence_note: Selected derivations and reported controls read; proofs/code not independently verified. Primary first-publication date is October 8, unlike some secondary October 9 dates.

evidence_status: Community-triggered catalog-only proposal. v1: 2026-09-07 19:39:38 UTC; v5: 2026-10-05 18:00:17 UTC. Full v4→v5 diff not performed; no claim that the discussed mechanisms were introduced in v5.
changes_existing_conclusion: No technical chapter change proposed; retain for future full-cost and controlled-interface follow-up.

title: Scaling Repeated-Data Pretraining: Batch Size, Regularization, and GPU-Time Tradeoffs
problem: 重复训练的收益上限依赖固定的 batch 与配方；单一 FLOPs 预算掩盖了小批训练的串行时长限制。
insight: 联合调整 batch、学习率、weight decay 和停止点，并通过每轮重打包、共享嵌入及嵌入衰减移动重复数据前沿；GPU 数与时间需分别约束。
method: Dense decoder-only training on fixed DCLM-Baseline pools; validation-selected batch/recipe sweeps and optimizer-step-equivalent GPU/time frontiers, with separately labeled H100 simulations.
result: Observed repeated-data validation loss has an interior batch optimum; repetition-aware recipes improve measured frontiers. This is conditional training-recipe evidence, not a universal epoch ceiling or measured frontier-scale speedup.
limitation: 153M–1.5B nominal untied sizes, smaller tied counts; 0.333B–3B unique tokens; AdamW/WSD and DCLM-specific. Validation-selected endpoints, limited pool-seed checks, no MoE validation. Exact-GPU/step-equivalent frontiers differ from availability upper bounds and end-to-end wall clock; 70B/10T is unvalidated illustrative extrapolation.
sections_read: Appendix B.1–B.2 and B.3 introductory metric discussion
reading_notes: Read methods, main result tables, limitations and resource-model conditions. Did not independently rerun experiments, audit code, verify every appendix fit or visually inspect paper figures. v1 says code/exact commands will be released upon acceptance.
changes_existing_conclusion: Extends conditional resource accounting; no universal scaling exponent or measured full-system speedup.

title: Mixed Precision Scaling Laws for Quantized Pretraining
problem: 仅把量化折算成有效参数或有效 token，可能漏掉随训练持续的前后向优化误差，改变精度预算最优点。
insight: 将容量差距与优化差距分离，给前后向精度各加残余误差项，再预测分层混合精度与条件计算最优分配。
method: Convex optimization bound and one-dimensional example motivate an empirical law; calibration/held-out loss fits on Qwen3-based and published Quartet grids; hardware-speedup-conditioned numerical allocation.
result: Held-out loss prediction improves against Quartet in the reported grids; the fitted model predicts higher preferred precision as compute grows under stated cost assumptions. Neither claim establishes a general LLM asymptotic theorem or measured end-to-end hardware gain.
limitation: Convex theory and a toy example only motivate the neural empirical form. Selected small dense-model/quantization grids; largest own model906M nonembedding/1.217B total. Form ablations use held-out errors. Cost ignores non-matmul operations and assumes speedups/equal block costs; mixed-pass allocation assumes transfer of layer-selection exponents.
reading_notes: Read main methods, results, fitting splits, architecture counts, theory assumptions and hardware-cost definition. Did not audit code, rerun fits, verify all appendix numerical optimization, or inspect figure pixels.
changes_existing_conclusion: Extends conditional resource accounting; no universal scaling exponent or measured full-system speedup.

title: Rethinking the Evaluation of Harness Evolution for Agents
problem: 框架搜索可能把同题反复试验误写为可迁移改进，且未与相同反馈权限下的简单搜索比较。
insight: 分开共享框架演化与单任务框架适应；将搜索和最终评估任务隔离，并明确不同实验的预算单位。
method: Terminal-Bench 2.1 uses three models, K=5 rollout rounds, two runs, and a 45/10/34 split; games compare task-specific adaptation against fixed-harness refinement.
result: The held-out mean is 63.2 for both initial and evolved harnesses. Game adaptation can help under action or wall-clock caps; those caps are not equal FLOPs.
limitation: Only one AHE-based implementation with external exploration disabled; small held-out set and two runs. Terminal editing cost excluded; ARC internal reasoning outside action cap; EdgeBench best-so-far includes host-only evaluations. No complete version diff or independent replication.
sections_read: Primary arXiv metadata/history; v4 §§1–5, Tables 1–9, A.1 cost/configuration/metrics, A.3 larger-budget controls, B.1 action accounting and B.2 artifact use, C.1 protocol/cost and Table 15. Case studies B.3 only partly read; no code/figure audit.
changes_existing_conclusion: Adds feedback access and held-out harness transfer to T5 budget accounting; does not reverse existing conditional test-time scaling claims.
evidence_status: First release July 14, latest revision October 5, so this is a window-eligible revision of older work, not an October first publication. Reading did not establish which claims were introduced by v3/v4.

title: Scaling Misuse Detection with Self-Assessment
problem: 全流量监控若重新编码长对话，验证器计算开销会限制覆盖率。
insight: 在回答后复用已有 KV cache 生成短评估，将强分类器的政策判断经 SFT/RL 蒸馏到提供服务的模型。
method: Synthetic conversations labeled by a Mythos Preview prompted teacher; assessment-only SFT plus schema and teacher-agreement rewards; offline screening after each response.
result: Reported production estimate under 2% added inference compute. At 1% teacher-defined FPR, Fable 5 recalls 78% of teacher flags and 94% of priority>=7 flags.
limitation: Teacher supplies both training and evaluation labels, so blind spots are not independently measured. Four-size SFT-only study uses a separate evaluation set without disclosed parameter counts or power-law fit. Not robust to a targeted adaptive attacker; no independent hardware/cost audit.
sections_read: Official report Introduction, Method/Training/Data, all Results subsections, Discussion/Limitations and footnotes; figures read through textual explanations, not digitized.
changes_existing_conclusion: Engineering example of marginal verification cost and correlated errors; no T5 body change recommended this week.
evidence_status: Publication date printed October 16, 2026. No revision history shown. Production recall is agreement with an automated teacher, not human-ground-truth detection; four-model scaling experiment cannot be combined with the production result.

title: Scaling Laws for Multimodal Data Mixtures
problem: 等比例双模态交互难以指导不等比例、重复受限的三模态训练。
insight: 把跨模态迁移、共享容量竞争和各模态重复收益分开建模。
method: 268-run fixed-family MoE grid, positive effective parameter/data transformations, repetition saturation, three unre-fitted validation runs.
result: Eight of nine validation losses within 2.51%; text in the non-text-heavy continuation differs by 6.73%.
limitation: 总参数包含非激活专家与embedding；视觉/音频验证loss含关联文本；主要单种子、固定tokenizer与架构；某些项并非在全部消融指标占优；继续预训练文本失败未被延长训练实证修复；15T示例仅外推。
sections_read: Metadata/history; §§1–6, §9; Appendix G fit validation/ablations, H held-outs, I router interpretation. Not all appendices or visual plots.
evidence_status: Primary metadata and selected sections; no independent reproduction, code audit or figure digitization.
changes_existing_conclusion: Adds directional mixing and capacity/repetition coupling to T7; no universal coefficients or repetition cutoff.
evidence_notes: 6 total-parameter scales, 457M–8.3B, up to 150B tokens; fixed 16 routed experts/top-2 plus one shared.
Held-outs: scratch 12.6B A3.8B at 200B tokens; two 8.3B A2.6B continuations from 100B text.
No-transfer full-fit RMSE slightly better by 0.7%; worst error worse. Full model not uniformly best under every criterion.
Table 1 versus appendix unimodal vision exponent differs; no exact vision exponent adopted.
Text-to-vision aggregate sign depends on task: understanding text-token and image-generation fits differ.
Audio near-zero transfer is unstable across folds and does not remove its capacity cost.
Claimed NeurIPS spotlight is author metadata, not independently checked venue acceptance.

title: More Than Seeing: Vision as Scalable Anchors in Native Multimodal Pre-Training
problem: 改变多模态比例会同时改变文本监督和预算，难以归因视觉内容的作用。
insight: 在相同数据顺序、长度、掩码和模型下，用无内容padding替换图像embedding。
method: Six MoE activated non-embedding scales 71M–3B, fixed multimodal/text input-token ratio 0.3, smoothed training text loss; matched img/pad runs.
result: Authors report nearly unchanged text frontiers and growing multimodal relative loss gaps, with selective text-only spatial transfer.
limitation: 非无图像位置的text-only基线；325B含图像patch；训练loss代理非留出测试loss；同run两种拟合法非独立验证；空间收益不单调，不能推断普遍推理增益或超出测量范围的幂律。
sections_read: Metadata/history; §§1–6 including methods, paired conditions and evaluation; appendix snippets only, no complete appendix/proof/code review.
evidence_status: Primary metadata and selected sections; no independent reproduction, code audit or figure digitization.
changes_existing_conclusion: Useful controlled-content complement; no new T7 body claim pending detailed evaluation and seed audit.

title: Frontier Pre-training at Microsoft AI
author_note: Institutional author; no named individual byline found on the inspected report.
version_read: Official web report accessed 2026-10-26; linked PDF URL contains ?v=2 without a documented revision date.
problem: Small-scale experiments can change the fresh-versus-repeated data regime and thereby select a recipe that transfers poorly.
insight: Preserve each source's repetition count while scaling tokens per active parameter; distinguish forecast validation from retrospective equal-loss efficiency fitting.
method: Source-scaled ladders; joint LR/weight-decay search; intermediate-scale prescription checks; separate BPB-versus-FLOPs and wall-clock comparisons.
result: Reported MAI-Base-2 ladder forecast and a separate retrospective FLOPs-efficiency interpolation. Proposed narrative emphasizes the protocol, not a universal speedup.
limitation: Internal evaluation data and simultaneous recipe changes; no independent reproduction. Figure 3 includes completed MAI-Base-2 in fitting. BPB/FLOPs does not establish generation quality or elapsed-time advantage.
sections_read: Official HTML technical sections from model comparison through scaling data; PDF pp.1–6 text including architecture table and Figures 2–4 labels/captions. No PDF pixel inspection, code audit, or full experiment rerun.
changes_existing_conclusion: Deepens T1 recipe/extrapolation conditions and links to T2 repetition; does not overturn Kaplan/Chinchilla or establish universal hyperparameter coefficients.
evidence_status: Newly discovered locally in the overlapping window, not published this calendar week. Website publication date printed 2026-10-15; no revision timeline disclosed.

title: Scaling Multilingual Mixture-of-Experts: How Language Coverage Changes Capacity and Compute Allocation
problem: Separate multilingual and MoE laws do not show whether added experts offset language-coverage costs or how preservation targets alter allocation.
insight: Jointly model active/stored capacity, experts, per-language exposure, coverage and diminishing repetition returns; evaluate shared languages under explicit resource constraints.
method: 64-configuration Top-1 grid, structured configuration holdouts, selected seed and mixture controls, larger-model stress test; separate logical and measured hardware accounting.
result: At matched target-language exposure, the common-language coverage penalty falls83% from dense to32 experts. Selected law mean holdout RMSE0.03319 versus refitted JointMoE(D_t)0.04617; not unseen-language generalization.
limitation: Fixed corpus/tokenizer/Top-1 recipe; primary grid one seed. Reused endpoints are correlated; formula selection uses validation comparisons; no independent final-test or replication established. Hardware and downstream-task benefits do not follow uniformly.
sections_read: v3 abstract and §§1–8; Appendix A setup/seeds/optimizer, B.1 fitting, B.2 selected ablation text/tables, B.3 parameterization, B.4–5 diagnostics/larger-model evaluation, C.1 and C.6 controls, D mixture controls, E allocation, F.1 protocol plus F.3 summary, G diagnostics, H physical cost. Large external benchmark tables and all figures not exhaustively audited; no code or experiment rerun.
changes_existing_conclusion: Adds coverage and per-language preservation as allocation axes in T3; deepens existing effective-data and cost boundaries rather than asserting every MoE scales better.
evidence_status: First release10/14; v2 10/15; v3 10/21. Current v3 read; complete v1-v3 semantic diff not performed.

title: On the Limits of Scale: Inverse Scaling in Vision-Language Models
problem: 总分提升可能掩盖同一家族发布模型在特定子任务上的退步。
insight: 用相同问题上的双向正确性翻转衡量净退步，再区分候选筛选、多重检验和提示协议的影响。
method: 19 released VLMs in four families, eight benchmarks/nine splits; 10,434 eligible within-family comparisons with at least 20 questions; net flip threshold five. Direct zero-shot greedy generation; paired CoT retest of both models on the 375 selected cases.
result: 375 screened cases; 16 survive BH correction across all 10,434 eligible comparisons. CoT leaves 96/375 above the same net-five threshold under a different generation budget.
limitation: 发布模型的训练、编码器与对齐存在混淆；375是比较案例而非独立任务。CoT较长预算和小模型下降也会改变差值；统计筛选及重叠比较限制因果/总体解释。不能据此断言参数增加造成逆向缩放。
sections_read: Metadata/history; §§1–5.5, selected §6 and limitations; Appendix A decoding/model table, selected B family tables, D multiple testing, E cross-family table, I active-parameter constraints, J option-order controls, K encoder tiers, L paired CoT design. Did not fully audit error taxonomy/human annotations, all case tables, code or figure pixels.
evidence_status: Primary selected-section review; no independent experimental reproduction or full version/code audit.
changes_existing_conclusion: T7 adds subtask-level evaluation as a boundary of aggregate multimodal progress; does not overturn aggregate scaling.
evidence_notes: BH denominator 10,434 yields 16; correcting only the 375 selected cases yields 54 and is not the adopted headline.
Most eligible comparisons favor larger models; 87% of 171 affected family-subtasks are non-monotonic.
CoT reruns both models, increases max tokens from 2048 to 4096, and smaller-model accuracy falls in 251/375 cases; attenuation is not all larger-model recovery.
Option-order audit covers only six strong BLINK cases, not all 375.
Total-parameter ordering mixes dense/MoE; Appendix I sensitivity checks do not supply matched independently trained recipes.
Code link https://github.com/saxenarohit/vlm_inverse_scaling observed in paper but not executed.

title: Scaling Laws for Generative Reward Models
problem: 静态偏好判断更准确的生成式奖励模型，未必为不断变化的策略提供更有效的在线优化反馈。
insight: 把 judge 的离线 Gold 标签准确率与其作为 online-DPO rewarder 的策略轨迹分别评估；同时检查训练方法、检查点、容量及参照评估器。
method: Qwen3 proxy judges 0.6B–14B; Answer-Only SFT versus Thinking GRPO; creative-writing policies 0.6B–8B; online DPO with fresh response pairs and frozen learned Qwen3-32B Gold evaluation.
result: Answer-Only has higher peak and top-five-average Gold Elo in 7/8 matched configurations despite lower static accuracy; 5/8 gaps have positive conditional bootstrap intervals. A different learned judge yields 42/80 Answer-Only wins, inconclusive overall.
limitation: Formats and objectives confounded; one model family and creative-writing domain; Gold is learned from Reddit vote-derived labels, not human adjudication of optimized outputs; retrospective Gold-selected snapshots; conditional match-row bootstrap excludes retraining/cluster uncertainty; no compute-matched allocation and incomplete historical token-cap provenance.
sections_read: Primary abs/history; HTML §§1–5, conclusion, Tables1–6, Appendix A.1–A.4 textual trajectory/provenance discussion, B.1–B.5 evaluation/scaling-fit/gradient identity/follow-up; prompt templates partly read. Figures not digitized, artifact code and training not run.
changes_existing_conclusion: Extends T4 overoptimization chain from reward capacity and pressure to the mismatch between static judge selection and online feedback usefulness; does not reverse prior conditional reward scaling findings.
evidence_status: First release 2026-10-22; metadata and key full-text sections checked. No later revision shown.

title: Harness Scaling for Generalizable Agentic Reinforcement Learning
problem: 通过单一执行框架训练的 agent 可能只适应该配置；测试时框架编辑并不自动带来可迁移改进。
insight: 在保持任务与环境语义的前提下，结构化改变执行框架，并区分留出组合迁移与外部黑箱框架迁移。
method: Five three-level harness factors, 18 pairwise-balanced training configurations from 243, K=2 nearby harnesses per task on successive updates; Qwen3-4B/30B-A3B, PPO/GRPO, 300 updates; disjoint tasks,18 held-out combinations,Claude Code/OpenClaw evaluation.
result: 4B GRPO transfers to unseen Claude Code with mean pass@1 37.22 versus33.38 for OpenClaw-trained GRPO over three benchmarks. Structured18 outperforms random18 and exhaustive243 at fixed update/rollout budget; K=2 outperforms matched Repeat-2.
limitation: Matched updates/rollouts do not establish equal token/FLOP/wall-clock cost; three evaluation runs do not establish independent-training uncertainty; rubric tasks use GPT-5.4; finite designed factors and two external harnesses; exhaustive243 includes white-box test configurations. No fitted universal exponent or direct replication of test-time harness editing.
sections_read: Primary abs/history; HTML §§1–6, Tables1–4; Appendix A variants, B design/construction and Table6, C.1–C.3 configuration,compaction,black-box baselines,held-out evaluation,Repeat-2 and single-harness sensitivity; D behavioral-judge protocol. Figures not digitized and no training/code execution.
changes_existing_conclusion: Adds training-time structured harness variation as a parallel repair to specialization; preserves the prior T5 distinction between test-time task adaptation and reusable harness improvement.
evidence_status: First release2026-10-21; no later revision shown. A small arithmetic check of the18 listed design rows confirms all two-factor level pairs occur twice; this is not experimental replication.
